title: I Found A Hidden Mark Inside Everything Claude Writes
description:
AI text watermarking is live, and almost nobody understands how it works. When a model writes, each word is sampled from a shortlist of plausible options, and a secret key biases which one wins. The meaning never changes and nothing visible is added, but the pattern is statistically detectable. Only two model families ship this today, Claude and Google Gemini. ChatGPT does not. This breaks down the real mechanism, who actually holds the detection key, and what the EU AI Act Article 50 requires from 2 August 2026.

Get the full breakdown here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1SH5iTiIclObBmAQWAQXnVA8owpl60WQwzY-tbV2bR3M/edit?usp=sharing
